A Rogue Trader is equipped with: Frag grenades; Krak grenades.
• Only one Rogue Trader per army.
• One Rogue Trader per army can be upgraded to a Rogue Trader Majoris for +15 points.
• Has access to weapons and gear from the Armory.
• The model may gain one Veteran ability.

Exotic Collection: At the start of each activation, the Rogue Trader may choose an enhancement for themselves and an attached unit:
1. Archaeotech Weapons: Ranged weapons gain +1 Strength.
2. Personal Shield Generators: Models gain the "Warded" ability.
3. Forbidden Stimulants: Models gain +1 Initiative.
The effect lasts until the Rogue Trader's next activation.
Rogue Trader Majoris: You may choose a second upgrade from the Exotic Collection each round.
